+_STRING_FIELDS = (
+    "episode_id",
+    "parent_episode_id",
+    "task",
+    "action_kind",
+    "outcome",
+    "failure_mode",
+    "route_key",
+    "policy_hint",
+)
+_FLOAT_FIELDS = ("reward_delta", "impact")
+_BOOL_FIELDS = ("capsule_candidate",)
+
+
+def _validate_scalar_fields(packet: ExperiencePacket) -> None:
+    for name in _STRING_FIELDS:
+        value = getattr(packet, name)
+        if value is not None and not isinstance(value, str):
+            raise TypeError(f"{name} must be a string or None")
+    for name in _FLOAT_FIELDS:
+        value = getattr(packet, name)
+        if value is not None and (
+            isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float))
+        ):
+            raise TypeError(f"{name} must be a float or None")
+    for name in _BOOL_FIELDS:
+        value = getattr(packet, name)
+        if value is not None and not isinstance(value, bool):
+            raise TypeError(f"{name} must be a boolean or None")
+
